items.title: Lars Edegran Interview, 1965-09-27
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Phil Ann is playing good. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, he played quite well I would say. And Manipole is the guy who does the best, keeps the band going best.
Yeah, he always seems to me to be working to help everybody. Oh yeah. Phil Ann is playing good.
Yeah. The Tormund players aren't very good. They're all right though. They aren't really bad but it's not very good.
